lead_raw_text:
This trigonal phase, with composition Sb3O6F3 (reduced formula SbO2F), crystallizes in space group R3m (No. 160) with 12 atoms per unit cell and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows F centers with 10 geometric neighbors, Sb centers with 3 F neighbors, and O centers with 4 neighbors (2 F, 2 O), with one O orbit forming a square-pyramidal motif. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between square-pyramidal O polyhedra, and corner-sharing between F-centered 10-vertex and square-pyramidal O polyhedra.
